mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_pool (id, workspace_id, pool_type, name, description, primary_cluster_id, total_nodes, allocated_nodes, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{poolType}, #{name}, #{description}, #{primaryClusterId}, #{totalNodes}, #{allocatedNodes}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_pool SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE resource_pool SET total_nodes = #{totalNodes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE resource_pool SET allocated_nodes = #{allocatedNodes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resource_pool ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM resource_pool WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY pool_type
SELECT * FROM resource_pool WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pool_type = #{poolType}
